description: Sim 92 — CMSTG non-linear structure growth. Computes non-linear P(k) via HALOFIT (Takahashi+2012) and sigma_8 for a Lambda0 scan, comparing to Planck CMB and weak lensing (KiDS-1000, DES Y3) observational constraints. Tests whether CMSTG at moderate Lambda0 naturally alleviates the sigma_8 tension. Primary output: sigma_8(Lambda0) and S8(Lambda0) = sigma_8*(Omega_m/0.3)^0.5.

lambda0_scan.note: 15 values covering 0 to 0.1; dense near BAO best-fit (0.003) and detection threshold (0.05)

base_cosmology.note: Joint CMB+BAO best-fit from SIM90. Held fixed so only Lambda0 varies.

cmstg_field.note: Lambda form: Lambda0*Psi^2. G_eff = 1/(1+16*pi*Lambda0*Psi^2). Same as SIM91.

linear_pk.note: Linear P(k) = A_s*(k/k_pivot)^(n_s-1)*T(k)^2 * (D_CMSTG/D_LCDM)^2. k in h/Mpc.

halofit.note: Non-linear P(k) via Takahashi+2012 HALOFIT fitting formulae. Applied to CMSTG linear P(k) with G_eff-modified growth.

sigma8.note: sigma_8 = sqrt(integral P(k)*W^2(k*8)*k^2/(2*pi^2) dk), W = top-hat.

S8.note: S8 = sigma_8 * (Omega_m/0.3)^0.5. Standard weak-lensing amplitude parameter.

observational_targets.note: Planck: Aghanim+2020 Table 2. KiDS-1000: Asgari+2021. DES Y3: Abbott+2022.

integration.note: RK45 integration of CMSTG FLRW+scalar system for growth factor.
